output.reason_for_conversation: understanding medication efficacy and whether to continue treatment
output.summary: User has been on Emgality for three months and reduced migraine days from 20 to 15 monthly (25% reduction), below the typical 50% clinical benchmark. The bot explained that three months is an early assessment point, that response can continue improving to six months, and that severity reduction also counts as progress. The user accepted this reframing and confirmed milder attacks when prompted to reflect. By the end the user felt reassured and had a concrete plan to track severity alongside frequency and discuss options with their neurologist.
